name: WASP-2
description: Star of 5,180 K, 153 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

quotes.title: WASP-2
quotes.card: WASP-2 is a binary star system located about 496 light-years away in the Delphinus constellation.
quotes.introduction: The primary is a magnitude 12 orange dwarf star, orbited by a red dwarf star on a wide orbit.
